depiction.primary_object: three-row bulleted list with square bullets and horizontal bars
modifiers: large checkmark in the bottom-right corner
depiction.composition: flat UI symbol with bottom-right badge

ambiguity: Very similar to other list and task icons (such as checkboxes on every row or a clipboard with a checkmark), and inside a to-do app it looks like a meta-UI icon rather than a distinct task subject.
task_intents: draft a packing or gear checklist
verify inventory against a master list
compile a guest or invite list
review onboarding steps for new hire

reasoning: Shows a three-line bulleted list with a checkmark in the bottom right, universally understood as a checklist or completed to-do list. Because it lives inside a task-planning app, it feels generic unless used specifically for tasks whose literal object is creating or running through a checklist, inventory, or packing list.
